newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - July 24.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:

* Rupert Murdoch's News Corp is moving toward an outright sale of its book-publishing unit HarperCollins, Wall Street sources said, in the latest move by News Corp. to rehabilitate its image on Wall Street.

* In their first joint public appearance Wednesday, ABC Entertainment president Jamie Tarses and newly installed chairman Stu Bloomberg tried to convince a skeptical crowd that they plan to work as "partners" to reverse the network's downward slide.
* Walt Disney has made a deal with Sting to compose songs for "Kingdom of the Sun," a new animated film project that will feature the voice of David Spade, sources said.
* Michael Douglas has agreed to star in Warner Bros 's "A Perfect Murder," with Andy Davis signing on to direct, sources said.
* MovieFone Inc was awarded $22.7 million Wednesday in its damages suit against equipment manufacturer Pacer-Cats by a panel of the American Arbitration Assn.

* In a case that shined a rare spotlight on the shadowy role of the theatrical dramaturg, a federal judge ruled Wednesday that the late "Rent" playwright Jonathan Larson never considered dramaturg Lynn M. Thompson a co-author of the musical that would become the biggest Broadway smash of the decade.
